items.docs: Create or update the Tenant. When creating tenant, platform generates Tenant Id as [time-based UUID](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universally_unique_identifier#Version_1_(date-time_and_MAC_address)). Default Rule Chain and Device profile are also generated for the new tenants automatically. The newly created Tenant Id will be present in the response. Specify existing Tenant Id id to update the Tenant. Referencing non-existing Tenant Id will cause 'Not Found' error.Remove 'id', 'tenantId' from t
